title: The Yard
summary: Accord's first off-world outpost, on the asteroid Talus. Mine, build a yard, and find the supply cache our archive says was placed here: it is gone, re-routed an hour ago to Thalassa (cache-rerouted). Opens Maren and Pip.

objectives.text: Build a Vehicle Bay for the yard
Find the supply cache on the north-east pad

notes: Chapter outposts in STORY.md §16; kept in chapter engram since it opens Thalassa's moons.
